thread:
Marina (Partnerships): Quick sync request - AcmeEdge asks to include per-seat changes in the hourly marketplace webhook so they can prorate mid-cycle. They want one stream not two. Risk: double-billing. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam (Integrations Eng): Today payloads are usage_units + sku_id. We can add seat_snapshot/seat_delta but need strict idempotency rules.

Nina (Billing): Ledger expects stable entitlement per invoice epoch. If partners send entitlement updates in the usage stream we must require an entitlement_sequence or we'll break reconciliation.

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge can emit an entitlement_sequence and idempotency_key. They prefer single webhook and will adapt.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Proposal: require seat_snapshot (absolute int) + entitlement_sequence (monotonic int) + idempotency_key. Keep usage_units for metering separate.

Alex (SRE): Also add a replay/backfill endpoint and rate limits. Instrument metric partner.entitlement.sequence.skew to detect gaps.

Nina (Billing): Billing will compute prorate adjustments (days_remaining/days_in_cycle * price_per_seat) in cents, use banker's rounding. Decide: apply adjustment to current open invoice if within cutoff, else queue to next invoice as pending credit.

Jordan (Partner Success): AcmeEdge wants credits applied immediately; they'll accept current-invoice-first behavior.

Sam (Integrations Eng): Draft webhook v2 example will be shared. We'll implement ack with last_applied_sequence on success and a replay test harness.

Nina (Billing): Action: I'll write RFC this week covering entitlement_sequence handling, prorate calc, rounding policy, and invoice-window cutoff. Tagging Legal for refunds language.

Alex (SRE): I'll add dashboards and a short runbook for out-of-order entitlements.

billing-bot: Created ticket INV-3421 "Entitlement sequence + prorate support" and linked to thread. :white_check_mark:

Marina (Partnerships): Timeline: partner beta by end of next sprint to align with AcmeEdge joint announcement. I'll follow up with schema once PRs are live. :thumbsup:
